title: Symbol Catalog (Base)
description: Universal scaffolding for any catalog of code symbols. Variants (decomposition, consumer audit, research snapshot, post-fix verification) extend this base via allOf + $ref.

catalog_date.description: ISO date when this catalog was produced (YYYY-MM-DD).

module_path.description: Optional dotted Python import path (e.g., pkg.geo.helpers). Required by some variants.

file_path.description: Optional repo-relative file path (e.g., src/pkg/geo/helpers.py). Required by some variants.

total_lines.description: Optional total line count for the cataloged module/file.

categories.description: Logical groupings within the catalog. Variants decide what categories mean (source sections, consumer tiers, risk bands, etc.).

summary.description: Aggregate counts. Variants extend with their own totals.

prefixItems.description: end line (1-indexed, inclusive); must be >= start (not enforceable in pure JSON Schema)

entry_count.description: Number of cataloged entries in this category.

cataloged_entry.description: Per-entry shape shared by all catalog variants. Variants extend this via allOf + $ref to add variant-specific fields.

name.description: Symbol name as it appears in source (or qualified name for consumers).

kind.description: Symbol kind. Variants narrow this enum to their domain (function/class/constant for decomposition; attribute/method/registry_field for consumer audits, etc.).

file_path.description: Repo-relative file path. Required for consumer-style entries that live outside the cataloged module.

docstring_summary.description: One-line summary of what the entry does or means.
